last_review.summary: FE-002 meets the task requirements and architecture constraints. Changes are confined to allowed paths, the transport interface matches the frozen internal contract, fixtures are contract-typed and fictional, mock results are cloned to protect canonical data, event replay honors sequence/resume and cancellation requirements, and approval decisions use idempotency keys without client-side authorization enforcement. Deterministic contract verification and the production build both passed.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; the contract hash check and the build are the deterministic gates.
src/contracts/ is vendored read-only from noktos-agent-backend at version 1.0.0 and verified against contracts.lock.
The access token lives in memory only: never in browser storage, never in a URL, never rendered or logged.
Frontend controls are user experience; the backend is the authorization boundary.
Development runs against fixtures until FE-013 swaps in the live transport.
